name: MenuAR
description: Preregistration of the MenuAR evaluation: a 540-trial field-robustness benchmark of composite-marker AR menus across illuminance, viewing angle, distance, and device tier, and a counterbalanced within-subject study (N = 50) testing whether in-situ AR presentation versus photographic menus changes diners' decision confidence, decision time, and perceived expectation congruence. The full design, measures, analysis plan, and pre-specified interpretation branches are in the attached document (Sections 4-5 of the submitted manuscript). No data have been collected at registration time.
